title: Pumpkin Bridge mod index
description: mod-index.json: written by the Gradle build in mod/ and read by the launcher. The launcher enforces the same rules and, beyond what a schema can say: node ids, file names and (loader, minecraft) cells are unique, and a strategy must suit its loader (fabricAddMods for fabric; fmlMavenRoot and fmlModFolders for neoforge and forge). A node without a verified entry is switched off.

modVersion.description: The launcher version the jars were built for. Used as a folder name.

plainName.description: One path segment: starts with a letter or digit, then letters, digits and . _ + -, at most 128 characters.

releaseId.description: An explicit Mojang release id such as 1.21.1 or 26.3. Never a range, a snapshot, a pre-release or a release candidate.

smoke.description: Day the headless smoke test of this node passed.

owner.description: Day the owner checked this cell by hand, or null.

loaderMin.description: Smallest loader version that runs the jar (Fabric loader, NeoForge, Forge). Compared numerically; a suffix after the digits is ignored.

file.description: Plain leaf file name of the jar. Unique per node.

verified.description: Absent or null: the cell is off.
